salary_details.details: MPYPIL pays a fixed consolidated pay per post (no separate allowances mentioned in the rule books); consolidated pay by category is summarised below. | For retired Central/State Government employees, monthly remuneration is fixed either by deducting pension from the last drawn salary, or at an amount equal to 50% of the last drawn salary. For employees currently working in Government and Non-Government sectors, remuneration may be paid in accordance with the last drawn gross salary, with the final decision resting with the Managing Director, MPYPIL.

selection_process: Senior and Higher Management) is through Interview cum Document Verification - there is no written examination stage specified in the rule books.
MPYPIL may shortlist candidates for Interview cum Document Verification based on eligibility criteria and merit. The final merit/selection list is prepared based on eligibility
suitability and the Interview cum Document Verification. Shortlisted candidates must bring all original documents supporting eligibility
age and category; two sets of self-attested photocopies; two recent passport-size colour photographs; and a copy of the submitted online application form. In case of a tie in final merit
preference goes to the elder candidate; if candidates are of the same age
preference goes to whoever has a higher percentage in the prescribed essential qualification. No candidate is appointed unless found medically fit
based on a certificate from a Government-recognized medical board. The Selection List and Waiting List remain valid for one year from publication
extendable by up to six months at the Appointing Authority's discretion.
how_to_apply: Register/log in and select the relevant MPYPIL recruitment category and post.
Fill in all fields of the online application form carefully.

Upload the required certificates/documents: 10th certificate, Higher Secondary, Graduation, essential qualification, experience certificates, caste certificate (if applicable), domicile certificate (if applicable), EWS certificate (same year, if applicable), OBC Non-Creamy Layer declaration (if applicable), and any other applicable documents.
Pay the non-refundable portal charge of ₹200 (excluding GST) through an online payment gateway or authorized MPOnline Kiosk.
Submit the application before the last date.

No offline applications are accepted. Candidates must have a valid, active email ID throughout the recruitment process, and need not send hard copies of the application or certificates to MPYPIL. MPYPIL is not responsible for network issues or interruptions during submission.

content_sections.heading: MPYPIL Vacancy 2026 - Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: MPYPIL Recruitment 2026 covers 399 posts across three separate categories. Category-wise vacancy tables are given below; the "No. of Posts" figure includes both the open count and the women's horizontal-reservation count for that category, as published in the official rule books. Category-wise: MPYPIL Junior Management vacancies include UR-72, ST-38, SC-29, OBC-52 and EWS-8 (figures include the women's horizontal-reservation count within each category, as per the rule book). Category-wise: MPYPIL Senior Management vacancies include UR-26, ST-10, SC-6, OBC-12 and EWS-0. Category-wise: MPYPIL Higher Management vacancies include UR-65, ST-27, SC-18, OBC-36 and EWS-0.

content_sections.heading: MPYPIL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The following general conditions apply across all three categories: The candidate must be an Indian citizen. Educational qualification and experience required differ post to post - see the qualification tables below. Age (including all relaxation) is specified per post - see the age limit tables below. Age is calculated as on 01 January 2026 , based only on the Class 10 (High School/Matriculation) passing certificate/mark sheet or another valid Government-issued document; no other document is accepted for age proof. Horizontal and vertical reservation benefits are available only to eligible Madhya Pradesh Domicile candidates. Non-domicile candidates are treated as Unreserved (UR). Candidates employed in Government, Semi-Government, Autonomous Bodies, PSUs, or other Government-controlled organisations must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of Interview cum Document Verification; failure to do so may lead to cancellation of candidature. Reservation for OBC candidates is subject to the final verdict in Writ Petition No. 5901/2019 (and connected matters) pending before the Madhya Pradesh High Court, Jabalpur; until then, recruitment follows the guidelines issued under letter No. F-07-46/2021/आ.प./एक dated 29.09.2022.

content_sections.heading: MPYPIL Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: MPYPIL pays a fixed consolidated pay per post (no separate allowances mentioned in the rule books); consolidated pay by category is summarised below. For retired Central/State Government employees, monthly remuneration is fixed either by deducting pension from the last drawn salary, or at an amount equal to 50% of the last drawn salary. For employees currently working in Government and Non-Government sectors, remuneration may be paid in accordance with the last drawn gross salary, with the final decision resting with the Managing Director, MPYPIL.

content_sections.heading: MPYPIL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates must pay a non-refundable portal charge of ₹200 (excluding GST) at the time of submitting the online application. This is the same for all three categories - the notification does not specify category-wise fee concessions (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Women), so no separate fee slab should be assumed. Payment is accepted only through an online payment gateway or an authorized MPOnline Kiosk. Only applications with successful payment will be considered; applications without successful payment will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: MPYPIL Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for all MPYPIL posts (Junior, Senior and Higher Management) is through Interview cum Document Verification - there is no written examination stage specified in the rule books. MPYPIL may shortlist candidates for Interview cum Document Verification based on eligibility criteria and merit. The final merit/selection list is prepared based on eligibility, qualification, experience, suitability and the Interview cum Document Verification. Shortlisted candidates must bring all original documents supporting eligibility, qualifications, experience, age and category; two sets of self-attested photocopies; two recent passport-size colour photographs; and a copy of the submitted online application form. In case of a tie in final merit, preference goes to the elder candidate; if candidates are of the same age, preference goes to whoever has a higher percentage in the prescribed essential qualification. No candidate is appointed unless found medically fit, based on a certificate from a Government-recognized medical board. The Selection List and Waiting List remain valid for one year from publication, extendable by up to six months at the Appointing Authority's discretion.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MPYPIL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the MPOnline portal: https://iforms.mponline.gov.in . Register/log in and select the relevant MPYPIL recruitment category and post. Fill in all fields of the online application form carefully. Upload the required certificates/documents: 10th certificate, Higher Secondary, Graduation, essential qualification, experience certificates, caste certificate (if applicable), domicile certificate (if applicable), EWS certificate (same year, if applicable), OBC Non-Creamy Layer declaration (if applicable), and any other applicable documents. Pay the non-refundable portal charge of ₹200 (excluding GST) through an online payment gateway or authorized MPOnline Kiosk. Submit the application before the last date. No offline applications are accepted. Candidates must have a valid, active email ID throughout the recruitment process, and need not send hard copies of the application or certificates to MPYPIL. MPYPIL is not responsible for network issues or interruptions during submission.

content_sections.heading: MPYPIL Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their applications through the official MPOnline portal.

content_sections.heading: MPYPIL Recruitment 2026: Other Important Conditions
content_sections.text: All appointments are contractual, for one year, extendable at MPYPIL's discretion; the Managing Director, MPYPIL is the Appointing Authority. Fulfilment of eligibility or inclusion in a merit/selection list does not confer any right to appointment; MPYPIL reserves the right to increase, decrease, modify or cancel vacancies or recruitment at any stage. The contractual appointment may be terminated by MPYPIL with one month's notice (or one month's consolidated pay in lieu), and without notice in cases such as suppression of material facts, forged documents, misconduct or breach of confidentiality. Selected candidates must maintain confidentiality of all official information, data and systems, both during and after the contract. Candidates with more than one living spouse (or women married to a man with a living wife), more living children than the prescribed limit, or convicted of certain offences are ineligible for appointment, subject to conditions in the rule book. All disputes are first resolved by the Appointing Authority; unresolved disputes go to the High Court of Madhya Pradesh. Candidates looking for more opportunities in the transport and public sector can also check the latest Madhya Pradesh Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for government vacancies in Bhopal and nearby regions can explore Bhopal Government Jobs for upcoming recruitment updates. Those interested in PSU and contractual career opportunities can also browse more PSU Jobs and Latest Government Jobs matching their qualifications. Candidates with technical qualifications such as B.Tech, Diploma, IT, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, and Automobile backgrounds can also explore Technical Government Jobs and Diploma Government Jobs across India.

faq.question: Q1. What is MPYPIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MPYPIL Recruitment 2026 is a drive by Madhya Pradesh Yatri Parivahan and Infrastructure Limited, Bhopal, to fill 399 contractual posts across Junior, Senior and Higher Management categories.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MPYPIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 399 vacancies in total - 199 in Junior Management, 54 in Senior Management, and 146 in Higher Management.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MPYPIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 18 August 2026. Applications open on 29 July 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for MPYPIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from Class 12 pass with an ITI diploma for Helper/Supervisor posts, to Graduation/Diploma/BE-BTech for Assistant Manager posts, MBA/CA/ICWA/Postgraduate qualifications for senior posts, and Postgraduate/professional qualifications for Chief General Manager posts. See the qualification tables above for each post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MPYPIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limits range from 25–45/50/63 years for Junior Management posts, 25–50 or 35–63 years for Senior Management posts, and 35–63 or 45–63 years for Higher Management posts, calculated as on 1 January 2026. See the age limit tables above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MPYPIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A non-refundable portal charge of ₹200 (excluding GST), payable online or via an authorized MPOnline Kiosk.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for MPYPIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted only through the MPOnline portal at iforms.mponline.gov.in. Offline applications are not accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MPYPIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through Interview cum Document Verification, based on eligibility, qualification, experience and suitability. There is no written exam.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for MPYPIL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Consolidated pay ranges from ₹32,760/- for Helper/Police Constable posts up to ₹2,06,808/- for Chief General Manager posts. See the salary table above for post-wise figures.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent Government job?
faq.answer: No. All MPYPIL posts under this recruitment are contractual, for a period of one year, extendable at MPYPIL's discretion.
